meta_description: M Phillips Heating & Plumbing in Wolverhampton. Expert central heating installation, repair and maintenance. Fast response, honest pricing. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Serving Wolverhampton Since 2008
hero_subhead: Reliable central heating repair and installation in Wolverhampton. Same-day callouts for breakdowns, no overnight charge.
services_heading: Complete Heating & Plumbing Services Across Wolverhampton
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full central heating installation, we handle all your heating and plumbing needs with expertise and care.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New boiler and system installation tailored to your home. We remove the old system, install your new one, and commission it fully — with 10-year warranty on selected models.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Quick diagnosis and repair of faulty boilers, with most jobs completed same day. Annual servicing keeps your system running safely and efficiently.

services.title: Emergency Heating Callouts
services.desc: No heating on a cold night? We're here 24/7. Our engineers carry common parts and aim to restore your warmth within hours, not days.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Replace cold radiators, bleed trapped air, or fit new ones throughout your home. We balance your system so every room heats evenly.

services.title: Pipe & Leak Repair
services.desc: Burst or leaking pipes fixed fast, with minimal disruption. We locate the fault and repair it properly, not with temporary patches.

services.title: System Powerflush & Cleaning
services.desc: Clears sludge and debris from your heating system to restore efficiency and reduce bills. Transforms sluggish heating into responsive warmth.

about_pullquote: I started M Phillips because I was sick of dodgy workmanship and overcharging.
about_para_1: M Phillips Heating & Plumbing was founded in 2008 with one goal: deliver honest, reliable heating and plumbing work to families across Wolverhampton. Over 16 years, we've earned the trust of over 1,000 local homes through straightforward pricing, expert Gas Safe engineers, and a reputation for turning up when we say we will.
about_para_2: We're not the cheapest, but we're fair. Customers return to us because we fix things properly the first time, explain what's wrong in plain English, and stand behind every job with a solid guarantee. Our van is always stocked with common parts, so most repairs happen same day — no waiting, no stress.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had no heating in the middle of January. Called M Phillips and Mark came out within the hour. Diagnosed a faulty pump, fitted a new one, and we were warm again by evening. Brilliant service, honest bloke, very fair price. Can't thank you enough.
reviews.author: David C.

reviews.text: Needed a new boiler before winter. The team explained all the options clearly, no pressure to buy the most expensive one. Installation was quick and tidy, and they left the kitchen spotless. Boiler's running beautifully. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Christine M.

reviews.text: Annual service on our heating system. Never had to wait long for an appointment, and the engineer was thorough. Found a small corrosion issue early and sorted it. Makes a real difference having someone you can trust.
reviews.author: Robert P.
